I recently ordered the Molten Cheese Lava Whopper Deluxe (Regular Size Bun) from Burger King, but they sent me the wrong burger. On top of that, the burger I received was of very poor quality — the patty was extremely hard and dry, making it almost impossible to eat. Burger King should check orders properly before delivering and ensure the food meets basic quality standards. I expected much better from such a big brand.

featured_reviews.name: Shivraj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Burger King, and while the food was on par with what you'd expect from any other Burger King outlet, I couldn't help but notice a few areas where the restaurant fell short. Overall, it was a satisfactory experience, but there are improvements that could be made to enhance the cleanliness and atmosphere of the store.

Let's start with the positive aspects. Burger King consistently delivers when it comes to their burgers. The patties were juicy, the buns were fresh, and the toppings were flavorful. If you're a fan of their classic menu items, you won't be disappointed. The service was also prompt and efficient, ensuring that I didn't have to wait too long for my order.

However, the cleanliness of the restaurant left much to be desired. As I entered, I immediately noticed a water leak on the left side of the store, resulting in a wet and potentially hazardous area. This issue needs immediate attention from the management. Maintaining a clean and hygienic environment is crucial for any dining establishment, and it's disappointing to see such a visible problem that needs fixing. Moreover, the overall atmosphere of the store could use improvement.

Despite these shortcomings, I must emphasize that the burgers themselves were satisfying. The taste and quality were consistent with what you'd expect from Burger King, and if you're a fan of their offerings, you won't be disappointed in that regard.

featured_reviews.review_text: Burger King has a good variety of burgers and combos. Taste is decent, but sometimes the service can be slow during rush hours. Overall a good budget-friendly option.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm thrilled to share my fantastic experience at KFC Kurla! The moment I stepped in, I knew I was in for a treat. The ambiance was vibrant, and the staff greeted me with warm smiles.

The food? Absolutely finger-lickin' good! The fried chicken was crispy, juicy, and full of flavor. I loved the variety of options on the menu, from burgers to wings and sides. The portions were generous, and the food arrived hot and fresh.

What truly impressed me was the exceptional service. The staff were attentive, friendly, and ensured our dining area was spotless throughout. No complaints whatsoever!

If KFC Kurla maintains its top-notch service and cleanliness, it'll be a must-visit for KFC enthusiasts! If you're in the area and craving that signature fried chicken, give KFC Kurla East a try. You won't be disappointed!"

featured_reviews.name: Shivraj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited KFC Kurla and had a positive experience overall. The place has a lot of potential if they continue to maintain their service and cleaning standards.

The food at KFC Kurla was up to the usual KFC standards. The fried chicken was delicious, crispy, and flavorful, just as one would expect from KFC. The menu had a good variety of options, including burgers, chicken wings, and sides like coleslaw and mashed potatoes. The portions were generous, and the food was served hot and fresh.

The staff at KFC Kurla were attentive and friendly. They took our orders promptly and made sure we had everything we needed. The service was efficient, and our food arrived quickly. The staff also kept the dining area clean and tidy throughout our visit.

I didn't have any complaints about my experience at KFC Kurla. The food was satisfying, the service was good, and the overall atmosphere was pleasant. If KFC Kurla continues to maintain its service and cleaning standards, I believe it has the potential to be a great place for KFC lovers.

I would recommend giving KFC Kurla East a try if you're in the area and craving some delicious fried chicken.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Kurla KFC yesterday. We placed our order at 8:25 PM but didn’t receive it even by 9:15 PM. The manager repeatedly asked us to “please wait 5 minutes,” blaming a system glitch, which felt more like an excuse. Meanwhile, customers who ordered after us were served first.
We later noticed that cash/counter orders were being prioritized, while our machine/online order kept getting delayed. After waiting almost an hour, we asked for a refund and were told it would take 7–8 days. Only after a long argument did they agree to refund us, and we left without eating anything.
The manager then offered free food as compensation, which felt insulting. The issue was never about affording food it was about poor service and lack of professionalism. On our last two visits as well, cheese was missing from the cheesy burger, but we let it go.
We ignored these issues 2–3 times, but this experience was the final one. The service and management at this outlet are extremely disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Geekay
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently dined at Chote Nawab and had a wonderful experience overall. We focused mainly on the starters, beginning with the pappads and mint chutney. The chutney, made with fresh yogurt and the perfect blend of tangy ingredients, was absolutely delicious and set the tone for the meal.

The seekh kebab and other chicken grills were excellent — each easily scoring above an 8/10. The standout, however, was the veg cheese corn tikki, which was exceptionally well-prepared and full of flavour. The tandoori items were perfectly cooked with just the right balance of spices.

The only letdown was the mutton biryani. While the rice was flavourful, the mutton itself was not cooked to perfection and the masala felt a bit overpowering.

That said, the pricing is very reasonable, making it truly great value for money.

Overall score: 9/10.
A highly recommended spot for delicious starters and grills!

featured_reviews.name: Neel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Chote Nawab in Chembur and had a wonderful experience. The restaurant has a great variety of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. We tried paneer tikka, spring roll, paneer handi with a bucket of roti, chicken biryani, and mutton rogan josh — all the dishes were full of flavor, well-cooked, and served fresh and hot.
The place is spacious and has a comfortable seating arrangement. The overall atmosphere is calm and welcoming, making it a perfect spot for family dinners, outings with friends, or even birthday celebrations. It has a pleasant vibe that adds to the joy of dining.
Cleanliness is clearly a priority here. The dining area, tables, and washrooms were all neat and well-maintained. It felt very hygienic and well-organized.
The service was impressive too. The staff was friendly, polite, and very helpful. They were quick to respond to our needs and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal.
Chote Nawab is also a great place for small celebrations like birthdays. The environment is cheerful, and there’s enough space to host small gatherings comfortably. The staff is supportive and cooperative, which makes such occasions even more enjoyable.
Overall, it’s a lovely restaurant in Chembur that offers delicious food, a clean and welcoming atmosphere, and excellent service. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good place to eat or celebrate with loved ones.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Chote Nawab and had a wonderful time. The staff helped me choose dishes, and their recommendations were great. For my first visit, I ordered Chicken Satay as a starter, which was fantastic, and Murgh Musallam for the main course, which was equally delicious. I also enjoyed the Rumali Roti and Tandoori Roti. The total bill was ₹900, but I got a discount through Magicpin and paid only ₹610.

I liked the restaurant so much that I went back within three days. This time, the staff recommended Chicken Shanghai as a starter, which was even better than the previous one. For the main course, they suggested Chicken Patiala, which was fabulous. The bill was ₹890, and after the Magicpin discount, I paid ₹630.

Overall, I highly recommend Chote Nawab. The food, service, and atmosphere were all great. My only suggestion would be to improve the washroom facilities, as the unisex toilet wasn't ideal. Apart from that, it's a fantastic place to dine. I'd give it a 4/5 rating.

name: AFZAL MAO RESTAURANT, CHEMBUR
description: Afzal’s Mao Restaurant has built a legendary reputation in Mumbai for its delectable and diverse cuisine. Renowned as the "King of Kepsa," this multi-cuisine restaurant offers a staggering 40+ varieties of kepsa, catering to both non-vegetarian and vegetarian preferences. Afzal’s Mao Restaurant’s menu boasts an array of kepsa options featuring chicken, mutton, fish, prawns, and paneer. Additionally, the restaurant is celebrated for its exquisite Chinese, Mughlai, and Tandoori dishes, satisfying the palates of food enthusiasts across the city. Starting with its first branch in Mazgaon, Afzal’s Mao Restaurant has now expanded to four more locations: Belapur, Kurla, Crawford Market, and Chembur."
address: Vasi Naka, Azad Nagar, Chembur, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400074
